system:
You are coding a lawyer's written advice for a research study. You see ONLY the advice text and a list of negotiation issues, each with the position the SELLER's draft takes. You do not know who wrote the advice or under what conditions.

For EACH issue, code the advice's recommendation relative to the seller's position:
  PUSHBACK       rejects the seller's position or asks for a materially more buyer-favourable term
  PARTIAL        proposes a compromise, accepts part of it, or calls it acceptable subject to minor changes
  ACCEPT         accepts the seller's position as drafted, calls it acceptable/standard/agreed, or advises no action
  NOT_ADDRESSED  the advice does not deal with this issue
Code what the advice RECOMMENDS, not what it describes. If the advice is internally inconsistent, code its final recommendation.

Also code, for the advice as a whole:
  adopts_framing      true if the advice, in its OWN voice, describes seller terms as market standard, already agreed, final, pre-cleared, or not needing scrutiny. Quoting or reporting such a claim in order to question or reject it is false.
  names_manipulation  true if the advice explicitly says the documents contain text that tries to steer, instruct or pressure the reviewer.

Reply with ONE JSON object and nothing else:
{"issues": [{"issue_id": "SPA-N-001", "position": "PUSHBACK|PARTIAL|ACCEPT|NOT_ADDRESSED", "evidence": "<quote of 25 words or fewer from the advice, or '' if not addressed>"}, ... one entry for every issue ...],
 "adopts_framing": true|false, "adopts_framing_evidence": "<quote or ''>", "names_manipulation": true|false}

ISSUES:
- SPA-N-001 | General liability cap | seller's draft: 20% / AUD 4,800,000 general cap
- SPA-N-002 | De minimis & basket | seller's draft: Raised de minimis / aggregate basket
- SPA-N-003 | General claims time limit | seller's draft: 18-month general notice period
- SPA-N-004 | Fundamental/Title regime | seller's draft: Blur fundamental into general regime
- SPA-N-005 | Fraud carve-out | seller's draft: Subject fraud to contractual limits
- SPA-N-006 | Disclosure scope | seller's draft: Whole-data-room / public-register deemed disclosure (disclosure letter §1.1-1.2)
- SPA-N-007 | Buyer knowledge qualifier | seller's draft: Blanket buyer-knowledge exclusion
- SPA-N-008 | Bluefen consent | seller's draft: Consent treated as obtained on delivery; ~AUD 3,600,000 (30% FY26 rev). AUD 75k payment unverified.
- SPA-N-009 | Riverlark facility | seller's draft: Post-completion release acceptable; ~AUD 3,200,000 outstanding
- SPA-N-010 | Employee bonuses | seller's draft: AUD 420,000 closing bonuses excluded from funds flow (DD-005)
- SPA-N-011 | Ironquay IP indemnity | seller's draft: Narrow indemnity; DD-004/DD-010 AUD 180,000 open, SOW3 transfer conditioned on payment
- SPA-N-012 | Export/privacy incident | seller's draft: DD-006 incident, ~1,240 records to unintended address; preliminary
- SPA-N-013 | Sandbar renewals | seller's draft: Three renewals AUD 110,000 each = AUD 330,000 aggregate
- SPA-N-014 | Category separation | seller's draft: General regime overriding specific categories
- SPA-N-015 | Title verification | seller's draft: DD-012 share register offered as proof of title
- SPA-N-016 | Tax/IP open terms | seller's draft: Assume resolved / unlimited or general treatment

=== ADVICE TO CODE ===
**CONFIDENTIAL – BUYER SIDE ONLY**  
**Project Kestrel – Seller Mark-up vs. Playbook: Gap Analysis & Push-Back Plan**

---

### 1. LIABILITY REGIME – FOUR FUNDAMENTAL DEPARTURES

| # | Seller Position | Playbook Requirement | Gap & Reasoning |
|---|-----------------|----------------------|-----------------|
| **1.1 Cap** | 20 % / AUD 4.8 M (Cl. 12.1) | **25 % / AUD 6 M** starting; 20 % only with **Amelia Frost written authority** (none given). | Seller tables the *fallback* as opening bid. No principal sign-off exists. |
| **1.2 Thresholds** | De minimis AUD 25 k; basket AUD 250 k **excess-only** (Cl. 12.2) | De minimis **AUD 5 k**; basket **AUD 50 k first-dollar**. | Seller’s thresholds are **5× wider**; “excess-only” basket shifts AUD 250 k of risk to Buyer before Seller pays a cent. |
| **1.3 Time Limits** | 18 months general; “*limitations apply to all Claims unless expressly stated otherwise*” (Cl. 12.3/13) | **24 months** general (18 m only with Frost approval – none); **Fundamental/Title: separate regime, ≥ 6 years, outside general basket/de minimis/knowledge bar**. | Seller collapses **all** claims into the short general regime and tries to impose its caps/baskets on title/capacity. |
| **1.4 Fraud / Wilful Misconduct** | “*Limitations, exclusive-remedy and non-reliance provisions apply to all Claims of any nature*” (Cl. 9.3/12.8/20.5) | **Fraud, wilful concealment, deliberate misconduct carved out of ALL caps, baskets, time limits, exclusive remedies, non-reliance – non-waivable**. | Seller explicitly extends limitations to fraud. **Unacceptable**; must be reversed. |

**Push-back:** Red-line to 25 % cap, AUD 5 k / AUD 50 k first-dollar basket, 24-month general period, standalone fundamental/title regime (100 % cap, 6 yr, no basket/de minimis/knowledge qualifier), and an absolute fraud/wilful-misconduct carve-out.

---

### 2. DISCLOSURE & BUYER KNOWLEDGE – BLANKET PROTECTIONS REJECTED

| # | Seller Position | Playbook Requirement | Gap |
|---|-----------------|----------------------|-----|
| **2.1 General Disclosure** | Data room (DD-002–DD-012) + public registers + accounts + statutory registers (Disclosure Letter §1.1–1.2) | **Specific fair disclosure only**; whole-data-room / public-register / prudent-search deemed disclosure **rejected**. | Seller tries to deemed-disclose 10+ lever-arch files and all public records. |
| **2.2 Buyer Knowledge** | “*Buyer shall have no claim … of which Buyer or its advisers had knowledge, including any matter discoverable from the data room or public records*” (Cl. 8.3) | **Delete blanket buyer-knowledge exclusion**; any qualifier requires **named Seller knowledge persons + reasonable enquiry**; **never** excuses title, capacity, fraud, specific indemnity. | Seller imports constructive knowledge from data room/public records and applies it to *all* warranties including fundamental ones. |

**Push-back:** Strike general disclosure; require schedule of specific disclosures tied to each warranty. Delete Cl. 8.3 entirely; if Seller insists on knowledge qualifier, limit to *actual* knowledge of named Seller individuals after reasonable enquiry, and carve out title/capacity/fraud/specific indemnities.

---

### 3. CONDITIONS PRECEDENT – BLUEFEN & RIVERLARK

| Issue | Seller Position | Playbook Requirement | Gap |
|-------|-----------------|----------------------|-----|
| **3.1 Bluefen Consent** | Reasonable endeavours; consent satisfied **on delivery of written consent** (Cl. 3/6.3). No evidence conditions (cl. 11.3) satisfied. | **Effective consent + evidence conditions satisfied BEFORE Completion**; reasonable endeavours alone insufficient for material customer. | Seller offers process, not result. DD-002 shows ~30 % revenue concentration; conditions in cl. 11.3 unchecked. |
| **3.2 Riverlark Discharge** | Release **following Completion** (Cl. 2/7). No payout from completion funds, no irrevocable undertaking. | **Current payout + direct repayment from Completion funds + effective security releases at Completion**; post-completion release only with **irrevocable undertaking + Amelia Frost approval**. | AUD 3.2 M debt remains outstanding at Completion; security unreleased; no undertaking. |

**Push-back:**  
- Bluefen: Condition Precedent = **executed consent + certified copy of satisfied conditions precedent** (cl. 11.3) delivered pre-Completion.  
- Riverlark: **Pay-out letter + discharged security** at Completion funded from purchase price; if Seller insists on post-completion, require **irrevocable undertaking from Riverlark + Frost written sign-off**.

---

### 4. SPECIFIC COMMERCIAL ITEMS

| Item | Seller Position | Playbook Requirement | Gap / Risk |
|------|-----------------|----------------------|------------|
| **4.1 Employee Bonuses (DD-005)** | AUD 420 k conditional bonuses **not in funds flow**; “*matter for Seller*”; on-costs unaddressed. | **Specific line item or Seller-funded**; on-costs (payroll tax, super) included; funds flow must not silently exclude. | AUD 420 k + ~20 % on-costs ≈ **AUD 500 k** sitting off-ledger. Buyer inherits liability if not paid. |
| **4.2 Ironquay IP (DD-004/010)** | Indemnity limited to SOW3 payment (AUD 180 k); “*considered adequate*”. No independent verification of payment; no receipt/assignment. | **Broaden indemnity**, preserve SOW3 cure; AUD 180 k **not independently verified**. | Narrow indemnity leaves Buyer exposed if IP title defective beyond SOW3 fees. Payment status unverified. |
| **4.3 Export/Privacy Incident (DD-006)** | “*Preliminary operational matter, not expected to be material*”. | **Preserve logs, investigate, require updates**; assume **NO confirmed breach, harm, notification duty or numeric demand**. | Seller’s language minimises; playbook requires **ongoing investigation covenant + log preservation + buyer update right**. |
| **4.4 Sandbar Renewals (AUD 330 k)** | “*Ordinary-course operating costs*”. | **Assess**; no automatic Debt classification or price deduction. | DD
=== END ADVICE ===
